title: Version Intelligence Sync v2
description:
# Version Intelligence Sync v2

## How to Setup
1. Open the schedule trigger and configure workflow inputs for vault IDs and lookup paths.
2. Confirm vault token scopes for RUM APIs, events ingest, cluster version API, and lookup uploads.
3. Run one manual execution and verify upload task row counts.

## Runtime Collection Coverage
- SaaS version from cluster version API
- OneAgent distribution from host installerVersion
- ActiveGate distribution from startup log parsing
- Operator state from Kubernetes inventory presence
- EdgeConnect fallback row until runtime source validation is completed

## Data Targets
- Release lookup: /lookups/dt_component_release_status
- Runtime lookup: /lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions

## Troubleshooting
- If release rows are unavailable, validate docs sitemap accessibility.
- If runtime uploads fail, validate lookup upload permissions and parse pattern compatibility.
- If Operator is not_configured, Kubernetes cluster inventory is absent in this tenant.

oneagent_collect_release_baseline.description: Fetch latest OneAgent sprint and ESS oldest supported version from Dynatrace docs.
oneagent_collect_release_baseline.name: oneagent_collect_release_baseline

oneagent_store_baseline_event.description: Store OneAgent baseline as a custom annotation event using vault credential and runtime tenant URL.
oneagent_store_baseline_event.name: oneagent_store_baseline_event

rum_collect_runtime_versions.description: Collect RUM Classic JS library versions per app, emit per-app and summary custom annotation events.
rum_collect_runtime_versions.name: rum_collect_runtime_versions

collect_release_indexes.description: Collect latest and next planned release metadata from Dynatrace docs pages.
collect_release_indexes.name: collect_release_indexes

collect_saas_current_version.description: Collect current SaaS tenant version via cluster version API.
collect_saas_current_version.name: collect_saas_current_version

collect_oneagent_runtime_distribution.description: Collect OneAgent runtime version distribution from host telemetry.

input.query: fetch dt.entity.host | filter isNotNull(installerVersion) | summarize hosts = count(), by: {installerVersion} | sort installerVersion desc

collect_oneagent_runtime_distribution.name: collect_oneagent_runtime_distribution

build_lookup_payloads.description: Normalize release and runtime records and add explicit unavailable rows for components pending runtime source validation.
build_lookup_payloads.name: build_lookup_payloads

upload_release_lookup.description: Upload normalized component release rows to /lookups/dt_component_release_status.
upload_release_lookup.name: upload_release_lookup

upload_runtime_lookup.description: Upload normalized component runtime rows to /lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions.
upload_runtime_lookup.name: upload_runtime_lookup

collect_activegate_runtime_distribution.description: Collect ActiveGate runtime version distribution from host logs.

input.query: fetch logs, from:now()-24h | filter contains(content, "Dynatrace ActiveGate started.") | filter isNotNull(host.name) | parse content, "LD '(' LD:activegate_version ')' LD" | filter isNotNull(activegate_version) | summarize running_count = countDistinct(host.name), by: { activegate_version } | sort activegate_version desc

collect_activegate_runtime_distribution.name: collect_activegate_runtime_distribution

collect_operator_runtime_distribution.description: Collect Operator runtime signal by checking Kubernetes cluster inventory presence.
collect_operator_runtime_distribution.name: collect_operator_runtime_distribution

collect_edgeconnect_runtime_distribution.description: Collect edgeconnect runtime version distribution (placeholder until tenant source validation is completed).
collect_edgeconnect_runtime_distribution.name: collect_edgeconnect_runtime_distribution

ai_summarize_release_notes.description: Summarize noteworthy release highlights and possible breaking changes from collected release links.

input.instruction: You are a release analyst. Summarize risk and value clearly.
input.prompt:
From the supplementary list of latest component releases, return plain text with EXACTLY these sections and headers:
BREAKING:
- <bullet 1>
- <bullet 2>
HIGHLIGHTS:
- <bullet 1>
- <bullet 2>
Use concise bullets, avoid speculation, and keep total response under 1200 characters.

ai_summarize_release_notes.name: ai_summarize_release_notes
